title: Norway Mourns the Death of King Harald V
subtitle: The beloved monarch, who led his nation for 35 years, passes away at 89

summary.en: Norway is in a period of national mourning following the death of King Harald V at the age of 89. The monarch passed away peacefully at a hospital in Oslo after being treated for a rare blood condition. His son, Haakon, has immediately succeeded him as King Haakon VIII. Throughout his 35-year reign, Harald was widely respected for modernizing the monarchy and acting as a unifying figure during difficult times. The new king now faces the challenge of leading the country while his family deals with recent public scandals.
summary.zh: 挪威正處於全國哀悼期，以紀念享壽八十九歲的哈拉爾五世國王。這位君主在因罕見血液疾病接受治療後，於奧斯陸的醫院平靜辭世。他的兒子哈康隨即繼位，成為哈康八世。在三十五年的統治期間，哈拉爾因推動王室現代化，並在艱難時刻扮演團結國家的角色而廣受尊崇。新國王目前面臨領導國家的挑戰，同時其家族也正處理近期的公眾醜聞。

paragraphs.en: Norway is mourning the loss of King Harald V, who died at the age of 89. The royal palace in Oslo announced that the king passed away peacefully on Friday morning at the national hospital. According to BBC News, the king had been receiving medical care for a rare blood condition since the middle of August. Following the announcement, the royal flag at the palace was lowered to half-mast, and citizens began gathering outside to leave flowers, flags, and messages of support.
paragraphs.zh: 挪威正為哈拉爾五世（Harald V）國王的離世哀悼，享壽八十九歲。位於奧斯陸的王宮宣布，國王於週五上午在國家醫院平靜辭世。根據英國廣播公司新聞（BBC News）報導，國王自八月中旬起便因一種罕見的血液疾病接受醫療照護。消息公布後，王宮降半旗致哀，民眾也開始聚集在宮外，獻上鮮花、旗幟並留下支持的訊息。

paragraphs.en: King Harald served as the nation’s monarch for 35 years. He was a popular and modernizing leader who was often described as the “People’s King.” As reported by The Guardian, Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre expressed deep sadness, stating that the entire nation is in mourning and feels great gratitude for the king’s long life of service. Many world leaders also shared their condolences. Britain’s King Charles III remembered his “dear cousin” as a towering figure, while King Carl XVI Gustaf of Sweden called him a good friend to his family and to the Swedish people.
paragraphs.zh: 哈拉爾國王在位三十五年，是一位廣受愛戴且致力於現代化的領導者，常被形容為「人民的國王」。據《衛報》（The Guardian）報導，總理史托爾（Jonas Gahr Støre）表達了深切的悲痛，表示全國正處於哀悼之中，並對國王長年以來的奉獻深表感激。許多世界領袖也紛紛致哀。英國國王查爾斯三世（King Charles III）緬懷這位「親愛的表親」是一位傑出的人物，而瑞典國王卡爾十六世古斯塔夫（King Carl XVI Gustaf）則稱他是自己家族與瑞典人民的好友。

paragraphs.en: Harald was the first king born in Norway since the 14th century. His life was shaped by history; he was only three years old when Nazi Germany invaded Norway during World War Two. He and his family were forced to flee the country, eventually traveling to the United States for safety. He returned home after the war and later became a popular figure known for his down-to-earth personality. Historians and royal experts noted that he was never afraid to show emotion or humor, which helped him connect deeply with the Norwegian people. During his reign, he worked to make the royal family’s finances and health matters more transparent to the public.
paragraphs.zh: 哈拉爾是自十四世紀以來，第一位在挪威本土出生的國王。他的生命深受歷史影響；第二次世界大戰期間，納粹德國入侵挪威時，他年僅三歲。他與家人被迫逃離國土，最終前往美國尋求庇護。戰後他回到家鄉，後來以平易近人的個性聞名。歷史學家與王室專家指出，他從不避諱展現情感或幽默感，這使他能與挪威人民建立深厚連結。在位期間，他致力於讓王室的財務與健康狀況對公眾更加透明。

paragraphs.en: One of the most defining moments of his reign occurred after the 2011 attacks in Oslo and on the island of Utøya. During that time of national crisis, King Harald encouraged Norwegians to support one another and not let fear control their lives. He was seen as a force for stability, even as he faced his own health challenges, including a cancer operation in 2003 and the installation of a heart device called a pacemaker in 2024. Despite these difficulties, he refused to step down from his position, famously stating that the oath he took when he became king was a promise for life.
paragraphs.zh: 他統治期間最關鍵的時刻之一，發生在二〇一一年奧斯陸與烏托亞島的攻擊事件之後。在那段國家危機時期，哈拉爾國王鼓勵挪威人相互扶持，不要讓恐懼掌控生活。儘管他自己也面臨健康挑戰，包括二〇〇三年的癌症手術以及二〇二四年安裝心臟節律器，他仍被視為穩定的力量。儘管困難重重，他拒絕退位，並曾留下名言，表示他在登基時所立下的誓言是一生的承諾。

paragraphs.en: Following his death, his son, 53-year-old Haakon, has immediately become the new monarch, taking the name King Haakon VIII. According to Deutsche Welle, the new king has chosen the motto “Everything for Norway.” Haakon is expected to swear an oath to the constitution in parliament in the coming days. While Norway does not hold traditional coronation ceremonies—a formal event where a monarch is crowned—the new king may choose to have his reign blessed at a special ceremony.
paragraphs.zh: 在他逝世後，五十三歲的兒子哈康（Haakon）隨即繼位，成為新任君主，稱號為哈康八世（King Haakon VIII）。根據德國之聲（Deutsche Welle）報導，新國王選擇了「一切為了挪威」作為座右銘。預計哈康將在未來幾天於國會向憲法宣誓。雖然挪威沒有舉行傳統的加冕典禮（即君主受冠的正式儀式），但新國王可能會選擇在特別儀式中為其統治祈福。

paragraphs.en: King Haakon VIII begins his reign during a challenging time for the royal family. The new king and his wife, Mette-Marit, who will now become queen, have recently faced intense public scrutiny. The Guardian reports that these difficulties include criticism regarding Mette-Marit’s past association with the late American sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, as well as legal issues involving her son, Marius Borg Høiby. These scandals have created a difficult environment for the new king as he steps into his role as head of state.
paragraphs.zh: 哈康八世在王室面臨挑戰的時期開啟了他的統治。新國王與現已成為王后的梅特-瑪麗特（Mette-Marit），近期面臨嚴格的公眾檢視。《衛報》報導指出，這些困難包括外界對梅特-瑪麗特過去與已故美國性犯罪者艾普斯坦（Jeffrey Epstein）的往來，以及其子馬里烏斯（Marius Borg Høiby）涉及的法律問題所提出的批評。這些醜聞讓新國王在接任國家元首之際，處於艱難的環境中。

paragraphs.en: Despite these recent controversies, the focus in Norway remains on remembering the legacy of King Harald. Thousands of people have gathered at the royal palace to pay their respects. For many, he was a grandfather figure who guided the country with warmth and humility. As Prime Minister Støre noted, the late king helped the people of Norway see the best in themselves and in each other. As the country prepares for the funeral, the transition of power marks the end of an era and the beginning of a new chapter for the Norwegian monarchy.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管近期爭議不斷，挪威的焦點仍放在緬懷哈拉爾國王的遺產上。成千上萬的民眾聚集在王宮表達敬意。對許多人來說，他是一位以溫暖與謙遜引領國家的祖父級人物。正如史托爾總理所言，已故國王幫助挪威人民看見了自己與彼此最好的一面。隨著國家準備舉行國葬，權力的交接標誌著一個時代的結束，以及挪威君主制新篇章的開始。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To move something to a lower position, specifically in this context, to move a flag down the pole as a sign of mourning.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作形容詞（較低的），這裡作動詞用。文中：Following the announcement, the royal flag at the palace was lowered to half-mast, and citizens began gathering outside to leave flowers, flags, and messages of support.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To resign or leave a position of authority or responsibility.
keyTerms.noteZh: 字面意思容易誤解，這裡指放棄國王職位。文中：Despite these difficulties, he refused to step down from his position, famously stating that the oath he took when he became king was a promise for life.

keyTerms.definitionZh: 詳細的審查、密切的注視。
keyTerms.noteZh: 此詞在新聞報導中常見，指公眾或媒體對公眾人物的嚴格檢視。文中：The new king and his wife, Mette-Marit, who will now become queen, have recently faced intense public scrutiny.

quiz.question: What specific health-related event occurred in King Harald V's life in 2024?

options.A: He was diagnosed with a rare blood condition.
options.B: He underwent a surgical operation for cancer.
options.C: He had a pacemaker installed to assist his heart.
options.D: He received treatment for a serious injury sustained during the war.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，文章明確指出他在 2024 年安裝了心臟節律器（pacemaker）。選項 A 是在 8 月中旬發生的（第一段），而非 2024 年的特定事件。選項 B 的癌症手術發生在 2003 年，而非 2024 年。選項 D 屬於錯誤資訊，文章並未提及他在 2024 年有戰爭相關的受傷治療。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about King Harald V's attitude toward his royal duties?

options.A: He believed that a monarch should retire once their health begins to decline.
options.B: He viewed his position as a lifelong commitment that superseded personal health struggles.
options.C: He felt that his role was primarily ceremonial and carried little responsibility during crises.
options.D: He wanted to step down early to allow his son to gain more experience before his own death.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據第四段，國王即便面臨癌症和心臟問題，仍拒絕退位，並明確表示他對國王的誓言是「一生的承諾」（a promise for life）。選項 A 與文章陳述相反；選項 C 與他在 2011 年危機中擔任穩定力量的角色矛盾；選項 D 則完全未在文中提及，且與他堅持到最後的態度不符。

quiz.question: In the second paragraph, what does the word 'towering' most likely mean as used to describe King Harald V?

options.A: Physically taller than most other world leaders.
options.B: A person who is difficult to approach or communicate with.
options.C: Someone who is highly respected and influential.
options.D: A leader who ruled for an unusually long period of time.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。在此語境下，「towering figure」是指在地位、影響力或成就上非常傑出且令人敬仰的人物，並非指身高。選項 A 是對詞彙的字面誤解；選項 B 與文中描述他親民的形象完全相反；選項 D 雖然他執政時間長，但「towering」強調的是人格與地位的崇高，而非單純指時間長度。

quiz.question: Which of the following best summarizes the main focus of the article?

options.A: A detailed account of the scandals currently facing the new Norwegian royal family.
options.B: A historical analysis of why Norway stopped holding traditional coronation ceremonies.
options.C: A tribute to the life and legacy of King Harald V amidst a transition of power.
options.D: A comparison between the leadership styles of King Harald V and his son, King Haakon VIII.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文主要圍繞著已故國王 Harald V 的生平貢獻、他受人民愛戴的形象，以及他在位期間的關鍵時刻，並以權力轉移至新國王作為結尾。選項 A 僅是第六段的局部細節，並非全文主旨；選項 B 僅在第五段簡短提及，非核心議題；選項 D 文章並未對兩人進行深入的領導風格比較，因此不正確。
